fieldValues.title: WG Third-party ready: cycle close 2026-10-17
fieldValues.chose:
WG Third-party ready: cycle 2026-10-16 11:30 to 2026-10-17 11:30 UTC

1. Decisions for you: one.
- Fact: the standard says Field and Type names are snake_case, but all 151 Type, View, Composition, Blueprint and Vocabulary names in use are kebab-case. A builder found this when asked to enforce the rule (srs#236, P0, blocks the gate).
- Why it matters: whichever you pick becomes what third parties are told to follow; changing the written standard is yours, not the group's.
- Options and consequences: (1) rename all 151: text stays true, but it reaches the generator, every rendered spec page and every by-name reference, large and risky for no gain. (2) keep Field names snake_case, document Type and Vocabulary names as kebab-case, split the shared `name` Field: matches practice, small change. (3) grandfather the 151, enforce only for new names: no rewrite, rule stays half-enforced.
- Recommendation: option 2. Action needed: decide. Urgency: medium (srs#236 is blocked until you do; the safe `namespace` half goes ahead regardless).
- Record: proposed decision b80d2d1e (srs-programme PR below). Detail: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/issues/236
Still waiting on you from before: srs-vscode#135 (owner-merge); srs-rust#861 (doctor over MCP, your direction is relayed there, the split is not yet filed); srs-rust#683 (parked behind decision 31e9fd27, ratified 2026-10-16; the RFC is next).

2. Decided within mandate: no decision was ready to ratify. The builder's proposed decision 04b78189 (one definition filename scheme, srs-rust#1209) has the reviewer's assent and its PR merged (srs-rust#1405), but its record is still on srs-programme#154, not merged, so it stays proposed. No group session held. No owner ruling made this cycle was found in the group log.

3. Done: 5 group PRs merged (builder / reviewer / mandate):
- srs-rust#1402 reject inverse-form relationType on create (tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / relation-coherence R2, T007)
- srs-rust#1403 enforce RFC-022 Rev 4 advisory requiresRelation (tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / RFC-022 Rev 4, I-100)
- srs-rust#1404 reject gzip-compressed .srsj (tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / I-108, charter 00567bf1)
- srs-rust#1405 lifecycle and vocabulary files use the shared filename scheme (tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / charter 00567bf1, owner ruling 2026-10-10)
- srs-rust#1406 advisory diagnostics counted separately (tpr-builder / tpr-reviewer / charter 00567bf1, owner ruling 2026-10-10)
Every one has a quorum comment (verdict approve, gates green at the head sha). Issues closed by them: #559, #566, #1387, #1209, #700.

4. Stuck or lost: srs-rust#1407 (SKILL.md replacement) is approved (quorum 11:40 today) and will merge next upkeep; it is the one open group PR besides srs-vscode#135. srs-programme#115 (steward report 2026-10-12) still open and conflicted; srs-programme#154 (decision above) is behind master. needs-input inside the group: srs-rust#861, #683, #1198 (parked until ranked), srs#236 (escalated above). No red gates reported by runs, no claims to release.

5. Budget: 5 of 10 delegated merges this cycle; 1 open delegated PR (srs-rust#1407). Pause state: running (reports 10-12 to 10-16 carry a thumbs-up).
5b. Awaiting ratification: nothing recorded as proposed on master other than the charter articles; decision 04b78189 (about 1 day old) waits on its PR. Session to ratify: `clerk session --as owner --repo <srs-programme> --ratify all` (the-greenman/clerk; the TUI is `clerk --as owner`).

6. Next: ready and unparked issues for the group: srs-rust#704, #1132; srs-vscode#133 (and #134, already PR #135); 0 in srs, srs-web. Three more `ready` ones are stopped (#861, #683, #1198). Top 3 in the Builder's order (no local priorities, all P2, oldest first): srs-rust#704, srs-rust#1132, srs-vscode#133. Budget left: 5. **Queue running dry: 3 ready, budget 10. Needs feeding.** New work could come from the spec-to-implementation drift list, conformance gaps in unimplemented rulings, or unparking #1198 once SP-78 is ranked. What waits on the owner: the decision above, srs-vscode#135. Fed by the analyst: not yet run for this forecast; the daily 12:00 check will see it.

6b. Exercises: none open in the group log.

7. What we learned: the previous cycle merged 0 group PRs and this one merged 5, half the budget, which suggests the hourly builder and reviewer clocks are doing what the trigger fix intended. The ruling-backed backlog is nearly spent, so the constraint has moved from the trigger to the queue. A rule in the standard that disagrees with its own corpus (srs#236) surfaced only when someone tried to enforce it: worth a standing check that a convention's audit covers every entity that shares the field. Build trigger: ratified decisions across both logs are well over 10, so srs-web#560 (decision-log lens) is ready to unpark; flagged for you.
fieldValues.rationale: One escalation raised: srs#236 needs the owner to choose between renaming 151 definitions and amending the written naming rule; it is a change to the standard's text and so outside the group's boundary.
fieldValues.figures: merged by group 5/10; open 1; ready issues 7 (3 unparked workable); proposed decisions pending 1; paused: no
